dict.string: PLACEHOLDER FILE - generated by Claude to unblock `expo prebuild`/`npm run ios`. This is NOT a real Firebase config. Download the real GoogleService-Info.plist for bundle id com.mitro.artist from the Firebase console (Project settings -> Your apps -> iOS app) and replace this file, then re-run `npx expo prebuild --platform ios --clean` (or delete ios/ and re-run `npm run ios`). Until then, Firebase/push notifications will not work on iOS - the rest of the app runs normally.
